mentions.name: GregTech New Horizons Nix flake
mentions.description: A Nix flake that automates deploying a GregTech New Horizons Minecraft server kept on the latest daily build. It is being packaged as a simple home-manager module for NixOS and macOS (darwin) that syncs the modpack manifest to a configured server (using a patched gtnh-daily-updater), plus a NixOS module that manages the server, replacing the extensive manual bootstrapping steps normally required.
mentions.problem: Running a GregTech New Horizons server normally requires a lot of administration with many manual bootstrapping steps, more than typical modded Minecraft servers.
mentions.source_excerpt: A Nix flake for a GregTech New Horizons server updated to the latest daily build. This normally requires quite a lot of administration with a ton of manual bootstrapping steps, and even though there are solutions for normal modded Minecraft servers, GTNH requires a bit more legwork. My hope is to make it an extremely simple home-manager module that works on NixOS and darwin that syncs the manifest to a configured server (had to patch Caedis' gtnh-daily-updater to achieve this), and a NixOS module that manages said server.
